tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan khyung lung gnyan gyi re ma ti'i gsol kha mkha' 'gro'i 'dzum zhal rab gsal bzhugs so// pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro khyung lung ma chen mo 'khor bcas mchod tshul 'di la/ thog mar lo rgyus kyi dbang du btang na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgya nag gi yul/ rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga/༈ ri bo lnga 'dus rtse la/ pha ni bdud kyi rgyal po mthong rtags dang / ma ni mu bdud kyi rgyal mo bzhin mi sdug pa dang 'tshogs pa las/ sras su bu mo bzhi skyes te/ shin tu mi bsrun pa 'jig rten 'phung bar byed pa bzhi yod pa las/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma he ru kas ༈ rta mgrin btul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung mar bskos so/ rgya nag rgyal po'i yul/༈ /yul rgya'i khri shing khri sgo ru/ dong kha'i gtsug lag khang na/ dar nag gi 'phan ring la rten bcas te/ srung ma mdzad kyin yod pa la/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bal yul nas/ slob dpon pad+ma spyan drangs dpal bsam yas bzhengs dus/ bka' srung klu ma gros pa la zhus pas/ ma gnang bas ༈ klu gdug pa yang che grags/ ma mo dang rgyal po gnyis dkor dad che bas/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ mon bu nag po khyung gshog du bsdus nas/ dong kha'i gtsug lag khang nas/ bdud mo bzhi'i rten dar nag gi 'phan rdzu 'phrul gyis brkus nas/ ha he hos/༈ srog snying nas drangs nas bkug bha rda hor gyis yul/༈ yang li yul lcang ra smug po nas rgyal po pe dkar spyan drangs lcam dral du byas nas/ dkor srung du bskos/༈ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i srung ma mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe/ zhang zhung gi rgyal po li man zhes bya ba des/ mnga' ris stod du/ khyung lung dngul mkhar gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la/ dkor srung med par/ slob dpon shān+tiṃ gar bhas/

dpal bsam yas nas bdud mo bzhi'i srog gi rten/ dar nag gi 'phan ring brkus nas/ lcam sring rnams kyi srog snying nas drangs/ byang lam bar ma nas yar byon/ la stod lhag pa che'o zer/ rgyal po pe dkar shar la log bud med rnams rdzas la chags pa che bas/ slob dpon gyi bka' phyir byon nas/༈ zangs mchu dmar por bsdus nas/ khyung lung dngul mkhar gyi srung ma mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'o/ /gcen mo che ba ni sman gyi gtso mo mdzad do/ /'byung ba bzhi'i kha lo sgyur/ gnam sman dkar mo zhes kyang bya/༈ bzhugs sa nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs/ rdo rje rab brtan ma yang bya/ phug bdag srid pa'i rgyal mo yang zer ro/ /de'i 'og ma ni bdud mo bgegs thams cad dang bsdongs/ byang gi 'brog thams cad kyang dbang du bsdus/ byang 'brog rgyal mo yang bya/ byang sman rgyal mo yang bya/ byang gi 'brog chen 'khor 'dul du grags pa de'o/ /༈ byang khri la dud ces bya ba na bzhugs/ yang de'i 'og ma ni/ gtsang sman rgyal mo yang bya/ dpal ldan legs 'byor ma yang bya/༈ gtsang gi grom pa rgyang na bzhugs/ grom pa rgyang gi lha khang gi srung ma mdzad pa rgyang ma zhes bya ba de'o/ /'og gi chung ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ de rnams kyi srung ma la bskos/༈ da lta yang byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi dgon pa yin tshad bzhugs/ ra sa'i 'dzim lha khang du/ sdong btsan gyi dmag dpon pa dang / lcam dral du byas te/ dkor srung mdzad pa'i khyung lung mar grags pa 'di'o/ /'di la sgrub pa'i lugs ni/ slob dpon pad+ma'i lugs dang / grub thob shān+tiṃ ghar+bhas mdzad pa/ byang sems zla rgyal gyis mdzad pa dang gsum las/ 'di slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i sgrub skor bskang bskul las kha tshar dang bcas pa/ man ngag bye ma reg gcod du grags pa'i yig sna 'ga' re 'dug pa gzhan du gsal/

'dir bskang ba'i rim pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'dir gnas pa'i mgon khang rnams sam/ gnas gang yang rung bar bdag bskyed gang byed kyi yi dam dang / khyung lung mched bzhi ming po bcas kyi sku bris 'bur gang rung gi steng 'og bar gsum du bla re go mtshon lpags rigs sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs mdzes shing brjid chags par bkram pa'i rten gyi drung stegs bang rim can kheb bcas kyi steng / bdag bskyed gang byed yi dam gyi gtor ma bshams pa las/ 'dir rta mgrin yang gsang la bdag bskyed byed pa'i dbang du btang nas/ dpal bshos snying gzugs ma sha mar dar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i g.yas su bdud rtsi/ g.yon du rak+ta/ steng bang rim gnyis par lha mo'i gtor ma 'brang rgyas dkar po dar dkar gyis brgyan pa'i mdun/ lug gzugs zan sogs la bcos pa/ de'i mtha' skor du dkar gsum mngar gsum shing thog sna tshogs spungs pa dang / yang dmar gtor gru gsum dar nag gur bcas dmar rgyan ci mdzes/ sha ba pho mo'i dang 'bri mo'i snying / bya mo nag mo sgo nga dang / ra sha khrag sna rnyed tshad mtha' la spungs pa'am/ yang na rdzas de dag ma 'byor yang dmar gtor sha rgyan can gyi chog ming po la btsan bshos zur gsum pa thod can mar/ sha dar mar lug dmar gyi snying bcas kyis brgyan pa'am/ yang na gtor rkyang gis chog gtor ma de rnams kyi drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ gser dngul sogs kyi snod du chang phud/ dkar phud phye mar/ zas sna sna tshogs dang / gzhan snod ji ltar rigs par/ ram rgya skyegs btsod/ zhu mkhan rnams kyis bkang ba gtsang sbra dang ldan par bshams/ mchod gtor rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ gu gul/ spos dkar/ bsang sna'i dud pas bdug la bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed ni/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/

'bring po yab yum rkyang sgrub/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa dang gsum 'byung ba las/ 'dir yab yum rkyang sgrub rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams laྎ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams laྎ dam pa'i chos rnams laྎ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams laྎ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang / bai ros/ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /pad+ma dbang chen bsgom bzlas ni/ /bdag gis sems can don du bgyi/ /zhes tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / /bai ros/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal med gyur cig /sems can bde la rtag par gnas/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi pad+ma dbang chen du gsal bas/ oṃ raṃ badz+ra kro dhā rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ tik+ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ raṃ a/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ ā lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ti pu dza te dzā hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma rak+ta hūm̐/ zhes pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃḥ

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rū tra baṃ/ bdud nag pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa sa bon gyi yig 'bru hrīḥdamar po dang / maṃ sngon por gyur/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas gsum nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spyan drangs sam ha ra na hūm̐/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru la thim pas/ pad+ma dmar po dang ban+dha khrag gis gang ba'i rnam par gyur/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brtan par bya/ hrīḥ ma hā kro dhā ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar nag g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil pa'i rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rta mgo ljang khu/ rngog ma dmar po/ phruṃ phruṃ ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher ba/ smin ma dang smra ra'i ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / g.yon gyi dang po ban+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis pas rgyu ma'i zhags pa/ g.yas gsum pas tsan+dan gyi be con dang / g.yon gsum pas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ skam po rlon pa rid pa ste thod phreng tshar gsum gyi do shal can/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang / glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/

stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shug 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par/ zhabs g.yas gnyis bskum zhing / g.yon gnyis brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ban+dha khrag gang yongs su gyur pa las/ de'i pang na yum chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas mi'i snying rlon pa bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa dung chen dmar 'khyil yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ spyan gsum khrag mig tu lta ba/ zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa nag po mun pa ltar 'thib pas sku sked yan chad non pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ yab kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+ma shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra a pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mri ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā his phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rang gi spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po las badz+ra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ bud+dha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ mchog mar oṃ dkar po las bud+dha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ swa rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rna ltag g.yas par swa ser po las rat+na he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ paṃ pad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag par paṃ dmar po las pad+ma he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ hā karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rna ltag g.yon par hā ljang khu las karma he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de lnga ka'ang thod skam gyi khang bu re re'i nang na bzhugs pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas sngar ltar sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod dang / sngags kyi rjes su/ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka gtor gsum gyis mchod/ rgyas par rtags bstod dam/ bsdu na/ kun mkhyen mus srad pas mdzad pa'i/༈ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor na/ /pad+ma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du/ /rnam shes gnas gyur pad+ma he ru ka /zhe sdang gnas dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yul/ /bde stong zung 'jug shes rab thabs dang rol/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khro mo'i sku/

/rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma/ /khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ces pas bstod/ bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gyen du kha phye ba'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyi sngags phreng kha dog dmar nag yig 'bru gyen du langs pas bskor bar bsam/ de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa nyi ma'i 'od zer ram/ gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa bzhin bun bun 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sangs dag 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga dang / yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams sogs nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa nyer spyod lnga la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa/ sman raka gtor gsum sogs nang gi mchod pa/ sbyor ba dang sgrol ba sogs gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gnas lugs rang ngo shes pas mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing thugs dam rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bye brag tu dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa rnams la 'od zer phog pa'i mod la tshar bcad/ thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lhan cig tu mtsho la ser chen babs pa bzhin du rang la chem gyis thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam la/

hrīḥ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar la ni snying po hrīḥ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu/ /sems can sgo gsum sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /zhes pas gsal btab nas rig ma yongs pa'i dar dang bcas pas/ hrīḥ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa dang / yum gyi thugs kar pad+ma'i lte bar ma yig 'dab ma la sngags phreng gi bskor ba la 'od zer spro bsdu gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su/ 'dzab bstod ni/ hrīḥ pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /dbang drag stobs chen rngams brjid gtum/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'gying zhing brjid/ /dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston/ /phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod/ /zhabs bzhis 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ros 'brug stong sgrog /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / 'dzab kyi dngos grub blangs ba ni/ hrīḥ khro rgyal dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyibs/ /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ta kṛta pad+ma shwa ri ma hā kro dha ha yaṃ gh+ri wa mā ma drag mo dun+tiṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang / oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la ho/ zhes brjod pas dngos grub thams cad rang nyid kyis thob cing brtan par bsam/ yig brgya lan gsum bzlas/ mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/

chos skyong gi mchod gtor rnams/ oṃ raṃ sogs kyis bsangs sbyangs nas bzung / rak+ta byin rlabs kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ rang pad+ma he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kha nas bh+rūṃ smug nag gcig 'phros/ bh+rūṃ bi sha bi shud+dha dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal/ zhes pas phyi rin po che las grub pa/ nang thod pa gtsigs pa'i sku mkhar gyi nang du/ sa bon/༈ ma bzhi dza dang lnga 'phros 'dus pa las/ oṃ badz+ra dun+tiṃ rak+sha pa dra ma bh+yoḥ zhes pas shar du/ gcen gnam sman dkar mo/ gser g.yus brgyan pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ phyag g.yas pa bya rgod kyi rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon pa mda' dar dmar po bsnams pa/ chibs su dung shwa dkar mo la chibs pa'o/ /bh+yo ma ma rak+sha ma bh+yoḥ zhes pas byang du 'brog sman rgyal mo/ sku mdog ljang nag ral pa dmar nag gtibs pa/ sku la dar nag gi thul pa gsol ba/ dbu la dar nag gi go cog bsnams pa/ phyag na dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ bdud g.yag rog po la chibs pa'o/ /kye dar ma ra dun bh+yo/ zhes pas/ lhor rdo rje legs 'byor ma/ sku mdog sngo nag sku la ber nag gsol ba/ dbu la bdud zhwa mnabs pa/ srog gcod kyi ral gri mdo la btags pa/ phyag na dar nag gi 'phan ring bsnams pa/ rting nas mon pa nag po 'breng zhing lag pa brdzes pa/ drel rta nag po la chibs pa'o/ /trag rak+sha snying kha rag ma bh+yo/ zhes pas/ nub tu bdud mo re ma ti/ sku mdog dmar nag khrag gi ral pa can/ spyan gcig khrag mig tu 'dug pa/ sku la g.yag lpags rlon pa gsol ba/ phyag g.yas mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi g.yobs pa/ g.yon thod phreng dang phur bu bsnams pa/ chibs su 'bri rgod dmar mo chibs pa'o/ /oṃ he sa shu la tri sha la dzaḥ zhes pas/ ming po lha btsan gyi rgyal po/ sku mdog ser po g.yu yi ral pa can/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen gsol ba/ dbu la le brgan gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/

phyag g.yas zhags pa dang / g.yon dar dmar gyi ru mtshon bsnams pa/ chibs su gro bo g.yu rngog la chibs pa/ 'khor lha btsan gyi rta dmag 'bum dang / sman 'brog mo bro rtse ba gsum/ 'brog mo 'bri g.yag la zhon pa 'bum dang / ma mo dal yams 'bebs pa 'bum/ gzhan yang bya nag dang / khyi nag dang / 'bri khyu ngar skad dang bcas pa 'bum 'bum khu dang bh+yo sgra di ri ri yod par bsam mo/ /de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ rgya yul bkra shis khri sgor/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / mnga' ris khyung lung dngul mkhar/ zhwa lu rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang / byang khri la dud/ gram pa rgyang gi lha khang / ra sa 'dzim la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can rnams nas/ rab 'jigs bdud mo mched bzhi ming po dang bcas dang / khyad par khyung lung gnyan gyi re ma ti 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥgong du bshad pa'i spos dud rnams sbyar rnga rol rkang gling shugs pa la sogs pa'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing / dar nag gis g.yab/ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas 'di skad do/ /kyai sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /shar phyogs rgya nag yul du bzhugs/ /de nas bar gyi bskal pa la/ /dpal gyi bsam yas gling na bzhugs/ /da lta mnga' ris stod du bzhugs/ /rdo rje dam can mkha' 'gro ma/ /srin mo rlung gi shugs can ma/ /'jigs gzugs bud med kha dog bzhi/ /drag mo rngams gzugs bdud mo'i tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir spyan 'dren gyi/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig /rin chen thod pa'i sku mkhar du/ /dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra a ti pu ho/ bh+yoḥ srin mo dmar nag 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgos 'dod bdud rtsi sman dang bcud/

/sha dang khrag dang rkang dang rus/ /glo snying mkha' ma nang khrol bcas/ /bshos skyems rin chen phud kyis mchod/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ re ma ti sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ zhes rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtog pas sman raka gtor gsum lan gsum bdun la sogs pas phul/ re ma ti sa pa ri wā ra/ a/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ ma gcig rdo rje khyung lung ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di bzhes la dpal chen pad+ma dbang chen dang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar spyi bye brag gi bstan pa srungs/ bstan 'dzin skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi legs tshogs spel/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing tho 'tshams pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig hūm̐ rdo rje nag mo re ma ti/ /khyung lung gnyan gyi spyan gcig ma/ /mnga' ris stod kyi mnga' bdag mo/ /gzhal yas dam pa rin chen 'dir/ /bzhugs pa'i gnas rten sku mkhar dang / /thugs dgongs dam rdzas 'phan rigs rnams/ /ma gcig khyung lung gnyan gyis bskor/ /gser skyogs dur pa lhag pa tsam/ /dngul skyogs phug ron gshibs pa tsam/ /dar zab 'ja' tshon spel ba tsam/ /ram dang rgya skyegs bre dang khal/ /btsod dang zhu mkhan ban ma bun/ /ma gcig khyung lung gnyan gyis bskor/ /spang na ri dwags mig gi shad/ /yu phugs bang mdzod dkor gyis bkang / /thugs dgongs spyan gzigs dam can rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis khyed sgrub pas/ /gnas khang mi nor phyugs rnams kun/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo rtsad nas chod/

/dkor nor khyer ba'i shul nas 'breng / /phung zhing gnas gtibs gyis la shog /nor rjes chod cig dam can ma/ /bh+yoḥbod khams yongs skyong bstan ma yongs kyi gtso/ /rab 'jigs dam can bdud mo mched bzhi ni/ /sngon tshe 'og min bde chen pho brang du/ /dbang chen rngams pas bka' dang dam la btags/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /shar phyogs rgya yi bkra shis khri sgor nas/ /spyan drangs bod yul bsam yas gtsug lag tu/ /dam la btags shing bstan pa'i srung mar bskos/ /de nas mnga' ris khyung lung dngul mkhar du/ /drag sngags slob dpon shan+tiṃ ghar+bha yis/ /bka' yi gnyer gtad bka' srung mchog tu grags/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tsan+d+ra dh+wa dza yi/ /rjes su 'brangs nas smu rdzing gtsug lag sogs/ /yongs su skyong ba'i dam can ma mo bzhi/ /khyad par tha chung bdud mo re ma ti/ /srin mo dmar nag khrag gi ral pa can/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i rak+ta'i mig gcig ma/ /phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi g.yab mo 'debs/ /g.yon pa dgra snying gzir ba'i lcags phur dang / /dam nyams rtsis la 'debs pa'i mgo phreng 'dzin/ /khrag rgyun thigs pa'i g.yag lpags rlon pa gsol/ /rlung gi shugs ldan 'bri rgod dmar nag chibs/ /baṃ ro rlon pa lnga brgya khal du bkal/ /dug sbrul nag po stong gi thag pas bsdams/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren btsan rgod rta zhon 'bum/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren nag mo g.yag zhon 'bum/ /rgyab kyi rjes 'brang byang 'brog 'jigs ma brgya/ /mdun gyi sna 'dren bdud g.yag drag po brgya/ /lcags khra hor pa brgya ni klad la lding / /khyi mo nag mo brgya ni rol du khrid/ /sprul pa'i bud med nag mos stong gsum khyab/ /mched lcam bdud btsan rgyal po phyi bzhin 'brangs/ /me rlung dmar nag 'tshubs pas phyogs mtha' bskor/ /sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyi sna 'dren ni/ /bskul lo bos so dam can bdud mo'i tshogs/

/'dir byon rnal 'byor bdag gi sgrub khang na/ /ma gcig 'bod cing brten pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /snyug rgod mda' dang dar nag 'phan ring dang / /gsang ba'i bla rdo srog 'khor snying sna'i tshogs/ /sha chen zan chen sman phud rak+ta'i tshogs/ /rus rkang don snying nang khrol bhan+dhar bcas/ /gsur chen spos dud rnga chen gdung dbyangs kyis/ /bskang ngo mchod do dam can bdud mo'i tshogs/ /'bod do bskul lo rdo rje khyung lung ma/ /gsang mtshan drag mo e ka mi zan ma/ /khyed la phrin las gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dgon gnas longs spyod dang / /dad pa'i sbyin bdag gus pa'i 'khor slob dang / /mi nor phyugs gsum bsags pa'i gtos bcas rnams/ /bcol lo gtad do bsrung skyob sba bar mdzod/༈ grangs bsog byed na bskul lo bos so nas bsrung skyob sba bar mdzod kyi bar la bya'o/ /nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ /'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /gal te zhi bas 'dul bar mi 'tshal ba'i/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mi dang mi ma yin/ /brnyas shing dmod pas bstan pa bshig byed na/ /de tshe dam can bdud mos bran gyis la/ /khro zhing 'khrugs pa'i lcags rta mjug ring zhon/ /ltas ngan sprul pas dgra yul ma lus khongs/ /kha rlangs nad kyi bu yug sprin ltar gtibs/ /mi lpags g.yab mos 'khor dang mched rnams bos/ /dpa' bo btsan gyi rta dmag de la bsgyur/ /srog gi bdud mo nag mos khram la thob/ /srog bdag gying gi cho 'phrul de la phob/ /ma bdud 'bum sde sle nag g.yab mo rdobs/ /bdud g.yag rog po'i tshogs kyis rwa brdar gyis/ /khyi mo nag mo'i tshogs kyis bla tshe khug /lcags khra hor las don snying spar gyis thob/ /rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs mas phyogs bcur gtor/ /mdor na khyed kyi mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /zhag dang za ma skad cig de nyid la/ /dgra bgegs log par lta ba'i tshogs rnams kun/

/thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yo ma gcig rdo rje khyung lung ma/ /sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /cho 'phrul chen pos 'og min du/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka'i/ /zhal mthong spyan sngar dam bcas ma/ /phyag 'tshal spyi bos zhabs blangs te/ /khyed kyi srog gi snying po phul/ /bar du slob dpon pad+ma yi/ /zhing bcu sgrol bar dbang yang bskur/ /yul ni mnga' ris stod shod du/ /phung byed shan+tiṃ ghar+bha yis/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /snyigs dus sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ bh+yoḥ phung byed dgra 'dul bstan ma kun gyi gtso/ /dkor bdag gnyan gyi khyung lung ma/ /yul ni stod ring lung gsum na/ /ti se gangs kyi g.yas rol na/ /ma pham g.yu mtsho'i g.yon rol na/ /yul ni bde ldan dngul mo gshongs/ /gnag khyu sol dong phye ba tsam/ /g.yag 'brog mang po 'du ba'i gnas/ /sman 'brog stong gi 'bros sa na/ /lha srin yongs kyi 'du sa na/ /mkhar ni khyung lung dngul mkhar gyi/ /stod na bdud kyi na bun 'thul/ /smad na khu 'phang sha ra ra/ /bdud bya nag po ling ma ling / /bdud khyi ngu zug di ri ri/ /ya mtshan sku mkhar nang shed na/ /yab ni bdud rje ma tho ka /yum ni 'brog sman rgyal mo la/ /mched bzhi ming po rgyal dang lnga/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ bh+yoḥ nang gi bu mo chen mo ni/ /gnam sman dkar mo stong gi rje/ /bzhugs ni nam mkha'i mthong na bzhugs/ /sku ni dkar mo sgeg mo la/ /na bza' dar dkar la'u gsol/ /gser g.yu spel ba'i lan tshar can/ /phyag g.yas bya rgyal rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /g.yon pa mda' bzang bya rgod bsnams/ /le brgan dmar po'i 'phur lce btags/ /chibs su dung shwa dkar mo chibs/ /dngul dkar me long phyis kyin gsal/ /bud med dkar mo stong gi rje/ /mi dang lha yi so pa yin/ /mi shes smra ba'i shag mkhan ma/

/mtshan gyi bya ra khyod kyi gyis/ /bden brdzun dpang po khyod kyi gyis/ /nyes legs zhal lce khyod kyi gyis/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ yang gcig de yi gcung mo ba/ /'brog mo ba lang dred sna ma/ /byang gri la dur de na bzhugs/ /byang sman byang 'brog kun gyi rje/ /sku mdog ljang nag khros pa la/ /sku la dar nag thul pa gsol/ /dbu la dar nag go cog gsol/ /g.yas na srog gcod ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pa dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar/ /chibs su bdud g.yag rog po chibs/ /ched nas drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /byang 'brog bdud mo dmag du sbron/ /skyes nag dgra la thibs se thib/ /bya nag sprin ltar thibs se thib/ /khyi nag ngu zug kang se te/ /'brongs po'i ngur skad dengs se deng / /bud med stong khams me re re/ /mtsho nag rba rlabs chi li li/ /ma bdud dmag sna dgra la drongs/ /nad mtshon sngon dmar dgra la thongs/ /dgra bo nad kyi drwa bar chug /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin la 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ yang gcig de yi gcung mo ba/ /dpal ldan rdo rje legs 'byor ma/ /bzhugs pa grom pa rgyang na bzhugs/ /zhi dang drag mo'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /zhi ba'i tshul du bzhugs tsam na/ /lho sman rgyal mo 'bring dhi skyongs/ /lho sman lho 'brog kun gyi rje/ /chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs/ /sku la rma bya'i thul pa gsol/ /mched 'ga' drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /sku mdog sngon mo khros pa ma/ /sku la ber nag dgu brtsegs gsol/ /dbu la bdud zhu gling mang gsol/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po chibs/ /dar nag 'phan lding klad la bskor/ /gsod pa'i mtshon cha sbo la btags/ /srog gcod mon pa phyi nas khrid/ /rig 'dzin pho mo gdong la bcug /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ nang gi bu mo tha chung ni/

/ma sman srog gi rgyal mo yin/ /sku mkhar khyung lung gnyan gyi bdag /sprul pa'i bud med dmar nag 'bum/ /khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra/ /khrag mig dmar mo log nas lta/ /bltas pas me 'od stong khams sreg /sku la g.yag lpags rlon pa gsol/ /mi mgo baṃ po'i phreng ba bgrang / /mi lpags g.yab rdo ma bdud sbran/ lcags kyi phur pa dgra snying 'debs/ /chibs su 'brang rgod dmar po chibs/ /mi ro lnga brgya khal du bkal/ /sbrul nag chun po'i ldir zor can/ /khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa/ /e ka nag mo mi zan ma/ /mo yi g.yas nas ru 'dren pa/ /dpa' bo btsan gyi rta dmag 'bum/ /khu dang bh+yo sgra dengs se deng / /mda' sgra gzhu sgra 'u ru ru/ /srab sgra smed sgra si li li/ /gri thab cho dgu dgra la thongs/ /mo yi g.yon nas ru 'dren pa/ /bud med mdzo g.yag zhon pa brgya/ /rbad na yang na bcos na dka'/ /bskul na yang na bsten na mthu/ /mchod na kha la rgyas na phung / /sle nag g.yab mo lings se ling / /khu dang bh+yo sgra dengs se deng / /ma bdud rgyal mo mgo phur ma/ /rims nad yams khrag dgra la thongs/ /ma mo'i rting la shugs gnon ma/ /byang sman 'brog mo rgyag brgya yis/ /snyan pa'i glu len kyu ru ru/ /mdzes pa'i bro rdung khrigs se khrigs/ /sman khyi gar byed phru lu lu/ /mo yi g.yon gyi sna 'dren ma/ /bdud g.yag rog po rwa bsnol brgya/ /ru brdar de ni zangs se zang / /rnga rtsed de ni thibs se thib/ /ngar skad drag po dgra la 'debs/ /sku mkhar khyung lung bsrung rtsa na/ /bud med nag mo stong du brdzu/ /bal nag go cog thibs se thib/ /'bri rgod dmar po re re zhon/ /sku mkhar khyung lung dngul gyi mkhar/ /phyogs bzhi bskor zhing gad mo 'debs/ /sku mkhar rtse la gshegs tsa na/ /lcags khra nag po stong du brdzu/ /mchu sder dgra bo'i snying la 'debs/ /gsang ba'i me lce mdzad tsa na/ /khyi mo nag mo stong du brdzu/

/dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khrid la shog /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /kyai khyed kyi ming po dgra lha ba/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ /btsan yul rngams pa'i ri thang mtshams/ /zangs brag rtse brgya zangs se zang / /rtse la rgod smug lings se ling / /logs la shwa rkyang sha ra ra/ /sked la gcan gzan ngu zhing zug /rtsa na dug mtsho khol lo lo/ /khrag mtsho khol ma me re re/ /khrag mtsho khol ma'i nang shed na/ /bse mkhar smug po ldems se ldem/ /gser gyi sgo bzhi khrigs se khrig /g.yu yi ba gam ye re re/ /ya mtshan sku mkhar nang shed na/ /pha dang yab la mtshan gsol ba/ /rmu rje gser gyi cod paṇa can/ /ma dang yum la mtshan gsol ba/ /'brog sman gyi ni rgyal mo lags/ /bu dang sras la mtshan gsol ba/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po lags/ /rin chen gser gyi zhal brjid pa/ /g.yu ral sngon po sha ra ra/ /sku la dar dmar ber chen gsol/ /za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can/ /rin chen gser gyi sked chings can/ /dbu la dar dmar 'gying thod can/ /chibs su gro bo g.yu rngog chibs/ /dar stan dmar po lhams se lham/ /stag sga khra bo wangs se wang / /zangs kyi yob chen khro lo lo/ /dngul gyi glo nan khyug se khyug /gser srab g.yu mthur si li li/ /dar dmar srab skyogs nu ru ru/ /sbrul nag gong smed sha ra ra/ /stag ral g.yas na wangs se wang / /gzig shubs g.yon na khyugs se khyug /btsan gyi gzer mda' dgra la rgyob/ /bse phub dmar po khyil li li/ /g.yas na btsan zhags dgra la 'phen/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo lug ltar zungs/ /g.yon pa dar dmar ru mtshon 'phyar/ /btsan dmag 'bum sde dar la bsdu/ /gdong drag 'jigs pa btsan gyi tshogs/ /mi dmar drag po klad la ldems se ldem/ /rta dmar rngog sogs 'og na khyugs se khyug /dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ru/ /zhags pa dmar mo brengs se breng / /de 'dra'i dmag dpon chen po la/

/rgya gar skad kyis mtshan gsol pa/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po lags/ /rgya gar phal pas mtshan gsol pa/ /gnod sbyin gtso bo tse'u dmar yin/ /bod kyi skad du mtshan gsol pa/ /che btsan rgyal po yang ni zer/ /mnga' ris stod du mtshan gsol pa/ /btsan rgyal mi kha mthu chen yin/ /sngon tshe pad ma'i rgyal po yis/ /khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa/ /rdo rje drag po thog rtsal rgod/ /mi gcig po la ming mang po/ /sku gcig po la 'khor mang po/ /dmar ze gro dmar rta ru 'dzugs/ /lug smug byang dmar 'ben du 'chang / /bshos bzang ldem pas thugs dam bskang / /phud rgod gtsang mas thugs dam bskang / /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la gtor ma sman raka dkar phud chang phud phye mar sogs khang thog gam sku mkhar ram/ sa gtsang sar phul lo/ /de nas pad+ma he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid mchod yul bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ /zhes me tog 'thor/ rten med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byor par mdzad du gsol/ /lag pa bsnol la mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs/ /rang pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bkra shis gang shes bya'o/ /zhes zangs bstan rmu rdzing lha mo'i gsol mchod 'di yang zangs bstan gnyer pa kun dga' phun tshogs sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i sgrub gzhung dang /
